name: Gakusen Toshi Asterisk Festa: Houka Kenran
original_name: 学戦都市アスタリスクフェスタ 鳳華絢爛
source:
In this action RPG game, play the events of The Asterisk War animation series! Live the life of hero Ayato Amagiri and experience Rikka Academy and the Phoenix Festa storyline. Players will go through simulated high school experiences while fighting in over the top tournaments.

[from [url=https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/aw-phoenix-festa-psvita/]Playstation site[/url]].
translation:
在这款动作RPG中，体验动画《学战都市Asterisk》的事件！扮演天雾绫斗，体验六花学园与凤凰星武祭的故事。玩家将在夸张的锦标赛中战斗，同时经历模拟高中生活。

[来源：[url=https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/aw-phoenix-festa-psvita/]PlayStation官网[/url]]
